title: 第629章 帝姬魔女魔佛皆入天庭第628章 拉开序幕
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
第629章帝姬、魔女、魔佛，皆入天庭
夜洐残魂之体灰飞烟灭。
生死轮回殿方向始终无人现身，众人便知晓，今日之战已无出现的可能。
各方势力踏空而去，各自四散离去。
而有关今日之事。
现场鱼龙混杂的势力，早已经无时无刻“现场直播”传回宗门，传到外界去。
引发诸多议论。
“终究是夜洐怯了，只敢遣一缕残魂现身，不敢与莫问天一战，这是没有自信能赢。”
“先前拿下神幽侯，真觉得他不可抵挡，如今看来，不过全靠抱紧魔尊大腿，真要让他堂堂正正一战，反而没了胆量。”
“可惜了，依旧不知道他与莫问天，到底谁更强，谁才是第一天骄。”
“肯定是莫问天，至少莫问天敢露面，而他只敢来一道残魂之体，如果有把握，岂会不应战，肯定是怕输了。”
“还说什么，没兴趣参与擂台之战，只分生死，连擂台之战都不敢参与，还谈什么生死之战。”
“魔尊她自己都不敢说，能拿下长公主殿下。”
“拿下神幽侯的威风，全靠魔尊，是魔尊可怕，而不是他夜洐。”
不应战的夜洐，主动要承受诸多非议。
而帝袍女子，威名便势不可挡。
“长公主霸气，你夜洐不是不敢来吗？就用天命珠这件夜洐绝不可能舍弃的至宝，逼他出来，不怕让他得到，这手霸道阳谋，令人折服。”
......
龙舟行宫上。
帝袍女子周身帝王威势缓缓敛去，她来到“莫问天”身前。

“敌方软弱避战，未能让你亲身体悟真正帝王之势，你需知道，参悟秦皇战经，不可像夜洐这般靠阴谋诡计，靠卑劣手段难登至尊大道，真正帝王势，是以煌煌正道横推一切，光明磊落，万法难挡。”
“莫问天”颔首，故作若有所思之态。
心中不以为然。
难登至尊王道？
可我领悟秦皇残经的速度，可是一日千里。
我不在乎过程，只要结果，凭什么就不算帝王势。
“接下来你潜心苦修秦皇残经，夯实根基，静候天庭开启之日。”帝袍女子眸光滚烫，她将一切都赌在莫问天身上。
天庭之内的秦皇祖庭真法，她接受不了半点失败。
天命珠，也不容有失，决不能落在夜洐手中。
帝袍女子担忧莫问天压力过大，吐露底牌：“你无需担忧，本宫会随你一同进入天庭。”
夜洐心头一震。
抬眼疑惑看着她。
不是天庭之路，唯有尊者之下才可踏入，你可是半步教主境，如何能入？
如果她能够全盛之驱进入天庭，以她的实力，在天庭之中谁能与之抗衡。
对夜洐而言，这并非是好消息。
帝袍女子解释道：“本宫本体不可入，本宫自有上古附身秘术，届时神魂寄附后辈躯体，仅存八境之巅战力，只是附身神魂受限，无缘参悟祖庭经法，参悟经法便交给你了，至于天命珠，本宫绝不让夜洐染指分毫。”
她眼底掠过一抹寒彻锋芒，杀意浮现。
莫问天神色波澜不惊。
杀我？
可惜，此次天庭让天下都会失望，我“夜洐”不参与。

同时夜洐心底忍不住生出诸多想法，她神魂附身进入？

content_en:
Chapter 629: The Emperor Ji, the Witch, and the Demon Buddha all enter the heaven
The body of the remaining soul of the night worm flew into ashes and disappeared.
No one showed up in the direction of the Reincarnation Hall of Life and Death, and everyone knew that there was no possibility of today's battle.
The forces from all sides flew into the air and scattered in all directions.
And about today’s matter.
The mixed forces at the scene have already been "live broadcasted" back to the sect and spread to the outside world all the time.
Caused a lot of discussion.
"After all, it was Ye Hao who was timid. He only dared to send out a wisp of his remnant soul and did not dare to fight Mo Wentian. This means he was not confident that he could win."
"Before, when I defeated Shenyouhou, I really felt that he was unstoppable. But now it seems that all I had to do was hold onto the Demon Lord's thighs. If I really want him to fight openly, I lose the courage."
"It's a pity, I still don't know who is stronger between him and Mo Wentian, and who is the number one genius."
"It must be Mo Wentian. At least Mo Wentian dares to show up, and he only dares to come with a body of remnant soul. If he is sure, he will not refuse to fight. He must be afraid of losing."
"What else can you say? I have no interest in participating in a battle in the ring. It only involves life and death. I don't even dare to participate in a battle in the ring. How can I talk about a battle of life and death?"
"The Demon Lord herself doesn't even dare to say that she can take down Her Royal Highness the Princess."
"The prestige of Shenyouhou is all due to the Demon Lord. It is the Demon Lord who is scary, not Ye Hu."
Ye Hao, who refused to fight, took the initiative to bear a lot of criticism.
And the reputation of a woman in imperial robes is unstoppable.
"The eldest princess is domineering, don't you Ye Hu dare to come? Just use the Pearl of Destiny, a treasure that Ye Hu will never give up, to force him out without fear of letting him get it. This domineering and scheming hand is impressive."
...
Dragon boat in the palace.
The imperial power around the woman in imperial robes slowly disappeared, and she came to "Mo Wentian".
"The enemy is weak and avoids fighting, which does not allow you to personally understand the true power of an emperor. You need to know that to understand the Qin Emperor's war scriptures, you cannot rely on conspiracy and despicable means to reach the supreme road like Ye Hui. The true power of an emperor is to overthrow everything with the righteous path, be upright and unstoppable."
"Mo Wentian" nodded, pretending to be thoughtful.
I didn't think so.
Is it difficult to ascend to the supreme king's path?
But the speed at which I understood Qinhuang's residual scriptures was rapid.
I don't care about the process, as long as the result, why can't I be regarded as an emperor?
"Next, you will devote yourself to studying the Qin Emperor's Fragments of Scripture, lay a solid foundation, and wait for the day when the heaven will open." The eyes of the woman in imperial robes were hot, and she bet everything on Mo Wentian.
She couldn't accept any failure in the Qin Emperor's ancestral court's true method in heaven.
There is no room for loss of the Destiny Pearl, and it must not fall into Ye Hui's hands.
The woman in imperial robes was worried that Mo Wentian was under too much pressure and revealed her trump card: "You don't need to worry, I will enter the heaven with you."
Ye Hao's heart was shaken.
He looked up at her questioningly.
It is not the road to heaven. Only those under the venerable can enter it. You are only half-step into the realm of the leader, how can you enter?
If she could enter the heaven in full glory, with her strength, no one in the heaven could compete with her.
For Ye Zhi, this is not good news.
The woman in imperial robes explained: "The main body of this palace cannot be entered. This palace has its own ancient secret technique of possession. By then, the soul will be attached to the body of the descendant, and only the top eight realms of fighting power will be left. However, the possessed soul is limited and has no chance to comprehend the ancestral court scriptures. The comprehension of the scriptures will be left to you. As for the Destiny Pearl, I will never let Ye Hao get his hands on it."
A flash of coldness flashed across her eyes, and murderous intent emerged.
Mo Wentian looked calm.
Kill me?
It's a pity that this time Heaven will disappoint the whole world, and I, "Ye Hu", will not participate.
At the same time, Ye Tao couldn't help but have many thoughts in his heart. Was she possessed by her soul?
